text:
Alex: Quick scheduling question — I just realized I have a calendar conflict for the infra interview on 2024-05-12 at 14:00. Can someone swap into that slot? Also we need to confirm who owns the debrief and who leads rubric item scoring for reliability.

Maya: I can cover 14:00 if Alex can take an earlier slot (12:30). Happy to swap.

Samir: If Maya takes 14:00, I can own the debrief. What's the rubric focus this round — system design or more ops/incident handling?

Alex: This round is infra + reliability. Rubric highlights:
```
- Availability reasoning (how they'd design for 99.9+ uptime)
- Incident triage & RCA approach
- State/consistency tradeoffs for caches/replication
- Communicating uncertainty & observable signal choices
```
Keep scores 1-4 per bullet, add a short comment if score <=2.

Lee: Prefer if we split the reliability bullets so no single person reads every deep ops answer. I'll take "Incident triage & RCA" and "Communicating uncertainty". Samir — can you take the availability reasoning and state tradeoffs?

Samir: Yep I can take availability + state tradeoffs. Lee that split works.

Maya: Confirmed swap with Alex. Alex can you update the candidate invite time? I'll ping People Ops to update the calendar.

Alex: Done — I updated the invite to 12:30 for me and left 14:00 for Maya. Also added a quick note in the candidate email about the panel change.

Maya: @People Ops Bot — can you update the roster and set a debrief reminder 30m after the interview?

People Ops Bot: Roster updated: Alex -> 12:30, Maya -> 14:00. Debrief owner: Samir. Debrief reminder scheduled 30m after interview end.

Jordan: Quick reminder for debriefs: please add a 2-line "strengths & risks" summary at the top and use the 1-4 rubric. Link to template: https://intranet/recruiting/debrief-template (paste in comments).

Samir: Also quick operational ask — can someone start recording and drop the link in #recruiting? I'm on support rotation and might be pulled.

Maya: I'll start recording and drop the recording link in the channel right after. Good luck everyone :crossed_fingers:

Alex: Thanks all — appreciate the fast swap. I'll be on the earlier slot and will leave a short candidate note in the debrief doc if anything unusual comes up.

Lee: Thanks team. See y'all in the panel.

People Ops Bot: Reminder set: debrief checklist will be DM'd to Samir 30m post-interview.
